# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be log probabilities <= 0)")
    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape == logp_with_result.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    # Compute weights
    horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted losses
    loss_with = -np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)

    # Compute baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Compute margin
    margin = L_minus - loss_with

    # Determine keep
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
